                                                      File # 30878


                    Rezone Summary and Recommendation
Public Body: Magna Township Planning Commission
Meeting Date: March 14, 2019
Parcel ID: 14322010660000
Current Zone: C-2 & R-M
Proposed Zone: C-2 & R-M
Property Address: 8291-8315 W. 3595 So.
Request: Rezone – Zone boundaries need to be adjusted to accommodate for the mixed use of retail buildings
and multi-family apartments

Planner: Diana Martinez
Planning Staff Recommendation: Approval
Applicant Name: Ben Logue




                                            PROJECT DESCRIPTION
The applicant is proposing to rezone the property, keeping the zoning of C-2 and R-M on the property by adjusting the
zoning delineation, in order to accommodate for his proposed mixed uses of retail buildings (store and restaurant) and
multiple family apartments.

The area affected by the rezone is only the area of the property that fronts onto 8400 West. The remaining amount of R-
M being moved to the east is approximately half an acre.

As seen on the zoning map attached, the northwest part of the property is currently zoned C-2, and the southwest part is
zoned R-M. For the applicant to locate retail pads on the West part of this property (along 8400 West) the zoning lines
must be reconfigured to allow these C-2 zoning uses.



The zoning maps below show the current zoning (top map) on the property. The C-2 zone is shown in red and the R-M is
shown to the south of that.

The bottom map shows the rezone area. The area in the hashed blue lines is the approximate area that would become all
C-2 and the remaining property would be R-M. Only ½ acre of the property would be added to the R-M zoning.
        Request: Rezone                              File #: 30878


Current Zoning




Proposed area of rezone (shown by blue hash lines)




Rezone Summary                                                       Page 2 of 3
         Request: Rezone                                                    File #: 30878




                             SITE & VICINITY DESCRIPTION (see attached map)
The property is located along the 8400 West corridor, near the intersection of 3500 South. Surrounding land uses to the
North and West are commercial. To the East and South is residential zoning.




                                   GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS
The property is located on a mapped General Plan corridor which encourages adaptable and flexible changes to zoning for
properties that have direct frontage onto the corridor.


  Compliance with the General Plan.                                                          Yes




                          ISSUES OF CONCERN/PROPOSED MITIGATION
There are no issues of concern which have been identified with this rezone proposal.

Before this application goes before the Magna Metro Township Council, the applicant should have a Traffic Impact Study
completed.




                                        NEIGHBORHOOD RESPONSE
There have been residents from the neighboring houses to the east that have expressed concerns about possible traffic and
parking impacts.
Other apprehensions that have been voiced from the neighboring residents are in regard to the eventual development of
this property, which will be under a future Conditional Use application.



                                        PLANNING STAFF ANALYSIS
The request is compatible with the General Plan Map and the goals of the Magna Community.



                                PLANNING STAFF RECOMMENDATION
Staff recommends that the Magna Metro Township Planning Commission make a recommendation of approval with
conditions for the rezone to the Magna Metro Township Council.

        Recommended condition:
            Applicant complete a Traffic Impact Study prior to going to the Magna Metro Township Council for approval.

                     Rezone Summary and Recommendation

Request: Rezone
Planner: Todd A. Draper, AICP
Planning Staff Recommendation: Approval
Applicant Name: Bryon Prince / Ivory Development


                                            PROJECT DESCRIPTION
The applicant (on behalf of Kennecott Utah Copper LLC, the current owner) is requesting approval to rezone approximately
9.10 acres of property from the current A1- z/c zone to the R-1-4 zone. The purpose of the rezone is to allow for
development of the property similar to that of the neighboring Gabler Grove Planned Development project. The applicant
will be seeking separate approval to include this subject property into the overall development plan for Gabler Grove.



                              SITE & VICINITY DESCRIPTION (see attached map)
The subject property lies South of the Riter Irrigation Canal and North of the Gabler Grove Planned Development project.
An existing Single-Family neighborhood is located to the West. The property currently consists of Agricultural land spread
across portions of multiple parcels.
         Request: Rezone                                                                File #: 30887




                                    GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS
The subject property is located in a mapped area of stability with limited change in zoning classification anticipated. The
subject property is immediately adjacent to the previously approved Gabler Grove Planned Development project and part
of the same parcels over which that development has been approved. Gabler Grove was approved by a Development
Agreement with the Magna Metro Township Council and multiple land owners. The Development agreement included a
complete development plan or Small Area Plan as part of the rezoning proposal at the time the development agreement
was entered into between the various owners and the Magna Metro Township, which is considered in practice as an
amendment to the General Plan. The applicant has indicated that they wish to develop the subject property in conjunction
with the Gabler Grove Development. The applicant has not submitted complete plans or an application for an amendment
to the development plans (Small Area Plan) for the Gabler Grove project, or for the subject property.

                                           ZONE CONSIDERATIONS

  Compatibility with existing buildings in terms of size, scale and height.                      No

                           ISSUES OF CONCERN/PROPOSED MITIGATION
The property to be rezoned is anticipated to later be subject to a development agreement with the Magna Metro Township
Council. The R-1-4 zone requires that single-family project developments be approved through the Conditional Use process.
The Magna Metro Township Planning Commission should have an opportunity to review and approve the conditional use.
This could occur as part of the review of a future development agreement for the property, or as a separate conditional use
application.

                                         NEIGHBORHOOD RESPONSE
No neighborhood response has been received regarding this proposal at the writing of this report.



                                     REVIEWING AGENCIES RESPONSE
Due to the timing of the application submittal, no outside agencies have been consulted regarding the rezone proposal. The
rezone could ultimately impact traffic above the levels originally contemplated in the adjacent Gabler Grove Planned
Development project. However, if the reductions in overall unit count occur as has been verbally indicated by Ivory
Development, a lesser traffic increase than previously anticipated may result.



                                          PLANNING STAFF ANALYSIS
The rezone, while significantly increasing potential density for the property, would allow it to be developed similarly to the
adjacent property within the Gabler Grove Planned Development.

Additional staff analysis of the traffic, economic, and other impacts of the rezone may occur as time permits and may be
provided at the Magna Metro Township Council meeting.



                                 PLANNING STAFF RECOMMENDATION
Planning Staff recommends that the Magna Metro Township Planning Commission forward a recommendation to the
Magna Metro Township Planning Commission that the 9.10 acres of subject property be rezoned to R-1-4. This
recommendation would be based upon the Planning Commission finding the following:
    1. That the resulting development pattern would be more consistent with that already approved for the adjoining
        planned development to the South of the subject property and South of the Riter canal.
    2. That the increased density would allow for more residential dwelling units to be built at a lower cost.
    3. That lower cost units are desirable for providing more affordable housing in the Magna Metro Township.

                                             PROJECT DESCRIPTION
The applicant on behalf of Kennecott Utah Copper LLC, Donald S. and Ilene Haslam, the Calvin G. Youngreen Revocable
Trust, the Karen Youngreen Revocable Trust, Entheos Academy, and Fig Colony Farms LLC (the current property owners) is
requesting approval to amend the Master Development Agreement for the Gabler Grove Planned Development. The
applicant seeks to add Ivory Development to the agreement, and to add additional property to the Planned Development.



                              SITE & VICINITY DESCRIPTION (see attached map)
The subject property lies South of the Riter Irrigation Canal and between existing single family homes. An existing Single-
Family neighborhood is located to the West. The property currently consists of Agricultural land spread across portions of
multiple parcels.
         Request: Text Amendment to Development Agreement                                                File #: 30898




                                    GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS
Gabler Grove was approved by a Development Agreement with the Magna Metro Township Council and multiple land
owners. The Development Agreement included a complete development plan or Small Area Plan as part of the
Development Agreement entered into between the various owners and the Magna Metro Township. This plan is
considered in practice to be an amendment to the General Plan. As part of this application file, the applicant has not
submitted complete plans detailing their proposed changes to the Small Area Plan, or Preliminary Subdivision Plats for the
Gabler Grove project. Staff is unable to analyze the considerations regarding changes to the General Plan as they have not
been submitted.

                             ISSUES OF CONCERN/PROPOSED MITIGATION
The biggest issue of concern is that the applicant (Ivory Development) does not have authorization from all property
owners subject to the Development Agreement necessary to submit a complete application. As of the writing of this report
a complete application has not been received by planning staff.

                                        NEIGHBORHOOD RESPONSE
No neighborhood response has been received regarding this proposal at the writing of this report.



                                    REVIEWING AGENCIES RESPONSE
Due to the timing of the application submittal, no outside agencies or reviewers have been consulted regarding analysis of
the potential impacts of these proposed changes to the Development Agreement.

                                       PLANNING STAFF ANALYSIS
The facts as understood by staff pertaining to the proposed changes are as follows:
    • Ivory Development intends to become a Developer within the “Gabler Grove” project.
    • Ivory Development desires to develop an additional 9.10 acres that are North of the approved Gabler
        Grove Planned Development.
    • Ivory Development desires that the additional 9.10 acres be rezoned and developed to the same or
        similar requirements that are applicable to the previously approved Gabler Grove Planned
        Development.
    • Ivory Development desires multiple amendments to the text of the original agreement. The proposed
        amendments include:
             o Inclusion of the additional 9.10 acres within the agreement
             o Removal of sections of the agreement pertaining to other portions of the development property
                 included in the original agreement but not under the potential future control of Ivory
                 Development.
             o Specific addition of Ivory Development by name as a developer in the agreement
             o Specific rezone of the additional 9.10 acres and re-distribution of zoning per a conceptual zoning
                 plan yet to.
             o Rezoning of a portion of property owned by Troy L and Corinna M. Belliston. This property
                 owner was never part of the original agreement. Applicant has not indicated if the intent is to
                 add the property or property owner into a Development Agreement or not.
             o Elimination of the intent to provide opens space and amenities in conjunction with an approved
                 preliminary plat (exhibit C)
             o Change to the definition of Open Space within the Project to remove exclusions to open space,
                 remove balcony allowances for RM zoned property, remove open space percentage
                 requirements for the project, remove discretionary elements originally afforded the developer
                 of the RM zoned parcel.
             o Removal of Magna’s review and approval authority pertaining to required recreational
                 amenities.
             o Removal of Magna’s ability to require bonds of the developer for required recreational
                 amenities which are deferred to later phases of the project.
             o Addition of a section regarding the Subordination of Conflicting Terms.
    • The current development agreement allows for reconfiguration of the subdivision plat and lots
        regardless of the underlying zoning. This would not change with the proposed changes.
    • The current development allows for re-assignment of development rights to future developers without
        need to amend the agreement. This would not change with the proposed changes.
    • No amended preliminary plat has been submitted (change to exhibit C) that matches with the
        conceptual zoning plan submitted.
    • Changes to identify the affected parcel numbers, acreage amounts, and other elements have not yet
        been identified in the proposed amendment.


                               PLANNING STAFF RECOMMENDATION
Planning Staff recommends that the Magna Metro Township Planning Commission continue the decision on a
recommendation to the Magna Metro Township Planning Commission for a period of up to 3 months to allow the
Developer the opportunity to submit a complete application and obtain the required written permission from all owners of
land subject to the proposed development agreement amendment that they consent to the submittal of an application to
amend the agreement. Also, to allow the applicant the opportunity to submit complete plans detailing the resulting
amendments and changes to the General Plan, Zoning, and preliminary Subdivision Plats.

Conditional Use Summary                                                                                       Page 4 of 5
        Request: Text Amendment to Development Agreement                                              File #: 30898


The staff recommendation would be based upon the Planning Commission finding the following:
    1. That the applicant has not made a complete application to staff for amending the development agreement,
         inclusive of plans detailing the changes to the General Plan and the preliminary subdivision plats.
    2. That written permission of the land owners is required for submittal of an application to change the development
         agreement, and that it has not been submitted.

Alternatively, the Planning Commission may wish to recommend denial based upon the incompleteness of the application,
or approval of the proposed text amendments subject to receipt of a complete application. Either motion would require
separate findings of the Planning Commission to support their recommendation.

modify the terms of the Agreement as set forth below.

        NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the promises, covenants, representations and
warranties hereinafter set forth, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and
sufficiency of which are acknowledged, Magna and Owners agree as follows:

          1. Definitions. All capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined herein shall have
   the same meanings assigned such terms in the Agreement.

          2. References to Property. All references to the Property shall be amended and restated
   consistent with the amended and restated Exhibit A attached hereto. These amended references
   include but are not limited to the following:

           (a) The parcel numbers below the MDA’s title shall be amended to state as follows:

(Parcel No. Pt. of _____________________________________________________________)

           (b) Recital A shall be amended to state: Owners own certain real property located in
               Magna, consisting of approximately __________ acres of the land located at
               _______________ and more particularly identified in the legal description attached
               to this Agreement as Exhibit A ("Property").

           (c) Exhibit A shall be deleted and replaced by the Exhibit A attached hereto.

           3. Recital Revisions.




                                                1
      (a) Recital B shall be amended and restated as follows:

      Ivory Development, LLC, a Utah limited liability company ("Ivory") has the right to
      purchase the Property from Owners and may become a Developer, as defined in Section
      3, below. Owners wish to effectuate the intended development of the Project as set forth
      herein.

      (b) A new recital “E” shall be added between Recitals currently designed as “D” and
          “E.” The following recitals be renumbered accordingly but shall not change in
          substance.

      (c) The new recital “E” shall state as follows:

          Ivory has since applied to have the previously approved zoning redistributed and to
          incorporate additional property into the Property. By signing this Amendment,
          Magna hereby approves Ivory’s proposed zoning of the Property. A copy of the
          revised zoning map approved by Magna for the Property is attached to this
          Agreement as Exhibit B.

      (d) Exhibit B shall be deleted and replaced by Exhibit B attached hereto.

      5. Phasing. Section 7.1 of the MDA shall be amended and restates as follows:

      Magna acknowledges that Developer or future assignees may develop the Project in
      Phases. The parties acknowledge that the most efficient and economic development of
      the Project depends on numerous factors, such as market conditions and demand,
      infrastructure planning, competition, the public interest and other similar factors.



                                           2
       Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the timing, sequencing, location
       and phasing of the Project, including but not limited to, construction of roads, water
       and storm drain systems, parks, and other public infrastructure improvements,
       including project improvements and off-site improvements, shall be as determined by
       Developer in its reasonable business judgment. The parties knowledge that the, current
       preliminary plat attached as Exhibit C was conceptual in nature and that Developer will
       seek, and the Council will approve, changes to the preliminary plat as long as such
       changes are consistent with this Agreement and Applicable Law.

      6. Improved Open Space and Park Improvements. Section 11 of the MDA shall be
amended and restates as follows:

       11.1. Open Space is defined as an area of land, water, or wetlands set aside or reserved
       for use by residents of the development or to beautify or create a feeling of openness
       in the Project, and may include an expanse of lawn, trees, plants, trails and other natural
       areas. Open Space may also include any open area of the Project including: required
       yards, park strip, setbacks, walkways, community amenities, and common or limited
       common areas.

       11.2. For each Phase which Developer develops, Developer, at its discretion, will
       select the minimum number of amenities from the approved list in accordance with the
       number of residential units being constructed in such Phase as they relate to the total
       number of units in the Project, as set forth on Exhibit D.

        7. System or Off-Site Improvements. Section 15 of the MDA shall be amended and
restates as follows:

       Magna may require that the portion, if any, of the system or off-site improvements
       which are necessary to provide utilities or services to the Project be completed prior
       to the issuance of any certificates of occupancy for the residential units within the
       such portion of the Project. Otherwise, Magna may not withhold or delay approval of
       applications or permits for the Project on completion of any system or off-site
       improvements. As set forth in Section 8.3, Magna will not require system or off-site
       improvements in excess of the capacity necessary to provide services to the Property
       without reimbursing Developer, allocating payment of costs proportionately between
       Developer and Magna consistent with Section 18, or entering into a reimbursement
       agreement satisfactory to Developer.

       8. Subordination of Conflicting Terms. In the event of a conflict in the terms and
conditions of this First Amendment with the terms and conditions of the Purchase Sale and
Option Agreement, the terms and conditions of this First Amendment shall be binding and
govern the conduct of the parties.

        9. No Other Changes. All provisions in the Purchase Agreement as it may have been
previously amended not specifically amended by this First Amendment shall remain in full
force and effect.
